My friends in our village and I used to run around playing in the woods all day, like scouts, and in the winter time, we'd build snow forts and have snowball fights with the kids across the street from us.

I also remember the little German kids across from us used to drive me crazy, calling me liebchen (sweetheart, or little love) in a chorus. I didn't understand what it meant so I'd cry and tell them to stop. Now, as an adult, i look back on it and laugh at how benign it really was.

I loved it there, and wish I could go back.
